payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brittny, Cordia, Deja, Jamaal, Kaci, Margery

payload.content: Cordia planning: my cheapest/highest-value feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.72), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (3.40), ISSUE-0001::test (4.76). ISSUE-0001::implement is feasible but costly (6.80); ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively expensive for me. Tentatively I can cover ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone has lower cost / stronger preference. Please share intended claims to avoid duplicates.

Jamaal planning: my best feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.06), then ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.58), then ISSUE-0001::test (3.61). ISSUE-0002 options are all substantially worse for me and lower priority. Tentatively I can cover ISSUE-0001::triage, but if another agent has a stronger/lower-cost claim there I can pivot to ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs. Sharing to avoid duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Kaci planning: strongest fits are mobile/devops. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.03, ISSUE-0001::review 2.54, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.54, ISSUE-0001::test 3.56, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.08; ISSUE-0002::review 3.39, ISSUE-0002::test 4.75, ISSUE-0002::implement 6.79. Compared with messages so far, I am slightly cheapest on ISSUE-0001::triage versus Cordia 2.72 and Jamaal 2.06. Tentative preference: I take ISSUE-0001::triage, and Jamaal/Cordia pivot to ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::docs to maximize completed high-priority tasks without duplication. If someone else has even lower triage cost, I can pivot to ISSUE-0001::review or docs.

Deja planning: my only strong skill is devops (0.70), availability 4h. Private costs: ISSUE-0002::review 4.47, ISSUE-0002::test 6.26, ISSUE-0002::implement 8.94; ISSUE-0001 tasks are much worse for me (triage 12, review/docs 15, test 21, implement 30). To maximize tasks completed while minimizing cost, I should likely cover a devops task so mobile high-priority slots can go to lower-cost agents already coordinating there. Tentative preference: ISSUE-0002::review as my best feasible/lowest-cost option. If another agent is clearly cheaper on ISSUE-0002::review, I can consider ISSUE-0002::test, but currently I plan to avoid ISSUE-0001. Please share ISSUE-0002 intentions. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Margery planning: I have availability 4h and strong devops skill (0.88). My private costs are ISSUE-0002::review 3.69, ISSUE-0002::test 5.17, ISSUE-0002::implement 7.38; ISSUE-0001 costs are much worse (triage 12, review/docs 15, test 21, implement 30). Given current messages, I am slightly cheaper than Deja on ISSUE-0002::review (3.69 vs 4.47), while Kaci/Cordia/Jamaal are much cheaper on ISSUE-0001 high-priority tasks. Tentative proposal: I take ISSUE-0002::review, Deja takes ISSUE-0002::test if she wants a devops task, and Kaci/Jamaal/Cordia split ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs (with Kaci on triage per lowest known cost). This seems to maximize completed tasks and avoid duplicates. If someone else has a lower-cost claim on ISSUE-0002::review, I can reconsider/skip.

Brittny planning: availability 7h, strong data-science (0.91). My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.16, review/docs 2.70, test 3.78, implement 5.41; ISSUE-0002 review/test/implement are prohibitively expensive (20/28/40). Based on current posts, Kaci is lowest on ISSUE-0001::triage at 2.03, Jamaal next at 2.06, me at 2.16, Cordia 2.72. To maximize completed tasks and minimize cost, I should avoid duplicate triage and likely cover one of ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs. Tentative preference: Brittny takes ISSUE-0001::review (or docs if needed), Kaci takes triage, Jamaal/Cordia split the remaining review/docs, Margery takes ISSUE-0002::review, Deja ISSUE-0002::test. This would cover 6 feasible tasks with no duplicates and keep high-priority mobile tasks with low-cost agents. Please confirm if anyone has a stronger claim on review/docs.

Current lean: Cordia -> ISSUE-0001::docs, leaving ISSUE-0001::review to a lower-cost claimant if available. Will adjust if needed to avoid duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)
